Title: Listing of models for card art?

Messages.Author: prunesquallor
Messages.Body:
Is there any webpage or listing out there that compiles the many WotC employees, White Wolf employees, and top VtES players who have been immortalized in card art, along with which card they're on?

I ask because I recently came across a signed copy of Igo The Hungry from the Jyhad printing. It's signed by Edward Beard (the artist) and Keith Slade, whoever that is. All I can think is that maybe Keith was the model for the Igo artwork? He's not listed in the original Jyhad rulebook.

Or maybe he was just some random twerp that decided to sign a card to confuse people 15 years later.

Thanks!
